Description: Control Star Citizen through the game's local telemetry API.

com.sokren.sc-telemetry.actor-action.Name: Actor Action
com.sokren.sc-telemetry.actor-action.Tooltip: Triggers a character action or an emote in Star Citizen.

com.sokren.sc-telemetry.morse-code.Name: Morse Code
com.sokren.sc-telemetry.morse-code.Tooltip: Flashes the flashlight in Morse code (the flashlight must be off at start).

com.sokren.sc-telemetry.actor-display.Name: Actor Display
com.sokren.sc-telemetry.actor-display.Tooltip: Shows a character vital (oxygen, health, temperature…) with a colored gauge.

com.sokren.sc-telemetry.ship-toggle.Name: Ship Toggle
com.sokren.sc-telemetry.ship-toggle.Tooltip: Ship function with live state: landing gear, lights, VTOL, decoupled, G-safe, power…

com.sokren.sc-telemetry.ship-action.Name: Ship Action
com.sokren.sc-telemetry.ship-action.Tooltip: Triggers a ship or seat command (flight ready, ATC, ping, quantum, seat modes…).
